digistore24.name: SOP — Digistore24
digistore24.purpose: Select valid, unique Digistore24 products and capture the required product and promotion details for review.
steps: Open the Digistore24 marketplace in the dedicated browser workspace.
Select the required marketplace category.
Inspect a product before adding it to DigiFlow.
Capture the product name, product URL, amount/price, currency when shown, and other essential details available on the product view.
Open the promotion/promo-link flow when a promotion link is required and capture the actual destination/promo URL.
Skip the product when the required URL, amount/price, or another essential field is missing.
Check the permanent product registry before accepting the product.
Send the accepted product to Review Center; do not treat collection as approval.
rules: Never intentionally add a duplicate product.
A product without a usable URL must be skipped.
A product without a usable amount/price must be skipped.
Do not invent missing product information.
Keep the original product URL and promotion URL distinct when both exist.
Final approval happens in Review Center.
checks: Product URL is present and copied accurately.
Product is not already in the permanent registry.
Promotion link is captured when required.
do_not_do: Do not fabricate price, commission, product claims, or promo links.
Do not overwrite an approved product with a new version.
Do not reuse an earlier product merely to fill the quota.

adobe_express.name: SOP — Adobe Express
adobe_express.purpose: Create a Pinterest-ready visual in Adobe Express Premium using an appropriate template/layout and export the finished image.
steps: Open Adobe Express in the dedicated browser workspace.
Find a suitable Pinterest design/template with the required vertical format.
Open the selected template/design.
Customize the design with the approved product-specific content and visual assets.
Keep the design readable, professional, and consistent with the product.
Review the finished design before export.
Download/export the final image.
Store the exported asset against the correct product in DigiFlow.
rules: Use the approved product information only.
Do not add unsupported claims, fabricated testimonials, or misleading guarantees.
The exported image must be associated with the correct product.
Do not overwrite an approved asset; create a new version when a revision is needed.
checks: Asset is linked to the correct product.
do_not_do: Do not publish from Adobe Express as a substitute for the Pinterest review step.
Do not use a misleading visual that does not match the product.
Do not overwrite an approved asset.

pinterest.name: SOP — Pinterest
pinterest.purpose: Prepare a Pinterest Pin using the approved image, title, description, destination URL, and keywords, while keeping final publishing manual.
steps: Open Pinterest in the dedicated browser workspace.
Start the Create Pin flow.
Attach the approved exported image.
Enter the approved Pin title.
Enter the approved Pin description.
Enter the product/promotion destination URL.
Add the approved keywords where the Pinterest flow provides the relevant field.
Review the complete Pin before publishing.
Leave the final Publish action for manual confirmation.
rules: Use the approved destination URL.
Use product-specific copy generated/reviewed in DigiFlow.
Do not fabricate statistics, testimonials, or guarantees.
Final Publish is always manual unless this rule is explicitly changed later.
checks: Destination URL is present and correct.
Pin is ready for manual review.
Publish has not been triggered automatically.
do_not_do: Do not substitute an unapproved image or URL.
Do not add unsupported claims to the Pin copy.

digistore24.name: SOP — Digistore24
digistore24.purpose: Find and review valid Digistore24 products before they enter the DigiFlow pipeline.
steps: Open the Digistore24 marketplace in the persistent browser workspace.
Navigate to the required marketplace category.
Review candidate products and open the product detail page.
Confirm the product has a usable URL, amount, and other essential details.
Obtain the affiliate/promotion link when required by the workflow.
Reject incomplete, duplicate, or unusable products.
Save only approved unique products to the Product Vault.
rules: Never save a product without a usable URL.
Never save a product without an amount.
Never reuse a previously selected product.
Keep category assignment accurate.
Do not fabricate missing product information.
checks: Not already in the permanent product registry
do_not_do: Do not bypass login or CAPTCHA.
Do not store Digistore24 passwords in DigiFlow.
Do not publish or promote a product before review approval.

adobe_express.name: SOP — Adobe Express
adobe_express.purpose: Create a Pinterest-ready visual using the persistent Adobe Express Premium workspace.
steps: Open Adobe Express in the persistent browser workspace.
Choose a suitable Pinterest 2:3 design/template.
Customize the design with approved product/content information.
Check layout, readability, branding, and image quality.
Export the finished image.
Save and associate the exported asset with the correct product/task.
rules: Use approved product/content information only.
Keep the final design suitable for Pinterest.
Do not invent product claims or testimonials.
Preserve the association between product, content, and asset.
do_not_do: Do not store Adobe passwords in DigiFlow.
Do not overwrite approved assets without creating a new version.
Do not publish to Pinterest from the Adobe step.

pinterest.name: SOP — Pinterest
pinterest.purpose: Prepare a Pinterest Pin from an approved product, copy, and image, stopping before final publication.
steps: Open Pinterest in the persistent browser workspace.
Start Create Pin.
Attach the approved image.
Enter the approved title and description.
Enter the destination/product URL.
Add relevant keywords where appropriate.
Validate all required fields.
Stop before Publish so the user can perform the final publication manually.
rules: Use only approved product URLs.
Use approved generated copy.
Keep descriptions product-specific and non-misleading.
Final Publish remains a manual user action.
do_not_do: Do not store Pinterest passwords in DigiFlow.
Do not click final Publish automatically.
Do not use fabricated statistics, testimonials, or guarantees.
